lines.character: 邻桌老妇人 / Older Woman Customer
lines.note: 凯茨杀青餐厅戏中邻桌老妇人对服务员的对白（饰演者为导演母亲埃丝特尔·莱纳）；AFI 百大电影台词第33；Wikiquote／IMDb quotes／片中字幕可核。

lines.text: 男人和女人做不成朋友——因为「性」那部分总会来捣乱。
lines.en: Men and women can't be friends because the sex part always gets in the way.
lines.note: 哈利的著名论断；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 我今晚来这儿，是因为当你意识到想和谁共度余生时，就会希望余生尽快开始。
lines.en: I came here tonight because when you realize you want to spend the rest of your life with somebody, you want the rest of your life to start as soon as possible.
lines.note: 新年夜跑来的告白；IMDb quotes 可查。
